faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University) Varanasi, commonly known as IIT (BHU) Varanasi, for an ICMR-funded research project in Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post for this recruitment drive is Project Research Scientist-I under the Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I position in this specific recruitment notification released by IIT BHU.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first class M. Pharm, M.S. (Pharm.), or M.Tech (Pharm) in Pharmacology, or a second class degree in the same with a Ph.D. in Pharmacology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Research Scientist-I position is set at 35 years, with age relaxations as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 56,000 plus 20% HRA per month for the first two years, followed by a 5% hike in the third year.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application via email to the designated authority is 26-10-2026, within 21 days of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for IIT BHU Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through email by sending their filled application format and self-attested documents directly to the specified professor's email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be emailed to Prof. Sairam Krishnamurthy at [email protected] with the correct subject line mentioning the post applied for.
